run_sac_continuous: run SAC reinforcement learning agent on a continuous control environment like HalfCheetah-v2
build_experiment_config: build a SAC experiment config with network factory and environment factory for continuous control tasks
sac_config: create a SACConfig with learning rate, n-step, target entropy, and input normalization settings
sac_builder: construct a SACBuilder from a SACConfig to build the SAC agent for training
run_distributed_experiment: launch a distributed SAC experiment with multiple actors using LaunchPad resources
